_comment: Edit the text values in this file to change what the connector-review.py script posts. Placeholders: {pr_num}, {pr_title}, {pr_url}, {next_branch}, {next_monday}. Do NOT change the marker strings — they are used for tracking.

follow_up_1.intro: just checking in on PR #{pr_num} — "{pr_title}". When you have a chance, please review and let us know if the KB looks good or if any changes are needed.

follow_up_2.intro: this is a second follow-up on PR #{pr_num} — "{pr_title}". We'd like to get this merged. If we don't hear back by end of next week, we'll proceed with the merge.

merge_standard.body: PR #{pr_num} has been merged into main. This update will go out with {next_branch} on {next_monday}. Thank you!

merge_escalation.body: After two follow-ups without a response, PR #{pr_num} has been merged into main. This update will go out with {next_branch} on {next_monday}.
merge_escalation.secondary_note: If you'd like any changes made to this article, please create a new Jira ticket and we'll address it in the next release. Thank you!
